/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
const conf = {
    output: 'export',
    distDir: 'build',
    assetPrefix: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH ? process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH : '/'}`,
    basePath: `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH ? process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH : ''}`,
    trailingSlash: !process.env.TRAILING_SLASH || process.env.TRAILING_SLASH !== 'off',
    env: {
        CURRENT_BRANCH: process.env.CURRENT_BRANCH ?? '',
    },
    images: {
        unoptimized: true, // Disable image optimization for static export compatibility
    },
    webpack: /** @type {import('next').NextConfig['webpack']} */ ((config) => {
        // Ignore source map warnings for @tabler/icons-react
        config.ignoreWarnings = [
            ...(config.ignoreWarnings || []),
            /Could not read source map .* tabler-icons-react\.js\.map/,
        ];

        return config
    }),
}

export default conf
